statement: Pinned Dolphin routes EEPROM and I2C spaces separately, bounds accesses and produces read/write errors; read replies are chunked separately from write ACKs.

applicability.revision: Original Remote and integrated Plus kept distinct where named
applicability.scope: Emulator evidence only: EmuSubroutines.cpp:253-323,402-525. Not a validated Wii EEPROM size,address-permission map or persistent-peripheral register model.
